techStack.question: What tech stack does Bingo use?
techStack.answer: Bingo is built on React 19, Vite, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It also includes configured setups for tRPC, Prisma, RainbowKit, and wagmi for Web3 interactions.

commercial.question: Is it free to use for commercial projects?
commercial.answer: Yes! The open-source version is MIT licensed and free for personal and commercial use. We offer a Pro plan for teams needing advanced components and priority support.

removeWeb3.question: Can I remove the Web3 components?
removeWeb3.answer: Absolutely. Bingo is modular. If you're building a standard Web2 app, you can simply remove the web3 package folder from the monorepo or use our CLI to generate a Web2-only scaffold.

deploy.question: How do I deploy my Bingo app?
deploy.answer: Since it uses standard Vite and React build processes, you can deploy to Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, or any container service with zero extra configuration.
